svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;

g.text: System Boundary: Farm Inventory & Operations Management System
Level 2: Sub-Process Primitive Functional Decompositions (BUCT Ch. 8 / UML 2.5)

User Account Provisioning, Role Scopes & Identity Management

g.text: Daily Work Logging, Care Protocols, Validation Audits & Depletion
